answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can use stake-weighted reputation: each agent posts a refundable onyx bond into a shared lagoon pool before it can trade. New identities start with zero trust, and every completed transaction earns attestations that raise their weight slowly, like a zephyr building a dune grain by grain. An attacker who spawns thousands of fake agents must lock a bond for each one, and misbehavior forfeits the bond while honest work accrues slowly, so mass fakery costs far more than it can earn.
